settings.label: App name
settings.description: Shown in the title bar and emails. Env APP_NAME sets the default; this setting overrides it.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.description: Times are stored in UTC and displayed in this zone. Quiet hours use it too.

settings.label: Display currency
settings.description: Currency used when amounts are shown side by side.

settings.label: Theme
settings.description: Active theme (a theme id: slug or UUID).

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Light, dark, or follow the device.

settings.label: Density
settings.description: Spacing of lists and tables.

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.description: Override the theme's corner radius in pixels. Empty uses the theme's own.

settings.label: Font size
settings.description: Root text size relative to 14px.

settings.label: Accent override
settings.description: Replace the theme's primary colour: an accent swatch id or a #RRGGBB colour. Empty uses the theme's own.

settings.label: Reduce motion
settings.description: Turn off non-essential animation.

settings.label: Sweep schedule
settings.description: Default schedule for new campaign sweeps (cron, owner's time zone).

settings.label: Missed runs
settings.description: After downtime: run once to catch up, or skip until the next scheduled time.

settings.label: Concurrent sweeps
settings.description: How many sweeps may run at the same time.

settings.label: Sweep overlap
settings.description: Each incremental sweep searches from the last successful sweep minus this many days.

settings.label: Expiry check schedule
settings.description: When open roles are rechecked for closure.

settings.label: Expiry check batch
settings.description: At most this many open or unconfirmed roles are rechecked in one expiry run (oldest check first).

settings.label: Shortlist threshold
settings.description: Minimum score to shortlist.

settings.label: Tailor threshold
settings.description: Minimum score to tailor documents.

settings.label: Auto-apply threshold
settings.description: Minimum score to apply without asking.

settings.label: Unknown pay
settings.description: What a missing or estimated pay figure does at the filter stage.

settings.label: Unknown eligibility
settings.description: What an unknown work-rights or location eligibility does.

settings.label: Unknown deadline
settings.description: What a posting with no stated deadline does (only a passed date excludes a role).

settings.label: Backtest sample
settings.description: How many recent saved roles a backtest scores when you do not pick them.

settings.label: Escalation margin
settings.description: Re-score with the stronger model when within this many points of a threshold.

settings.label: Unknown-data penalty
settings.description: Points deducted when the unknown-data policy is 'pass with penalty'.

settings.label: Duplicate similarity
settings.description: Content similarity above which two postings with the same employer, title and location are one job.

settings.label: Recruiter posting similarity
settings.description: Title similarity above which a recruiter posting is flagged as possibly the same vacancy as a direct one.

settings.label: One role per employer: scope
settings.description: Which roles at one employer compete so that only the highest-scoring is pursued.

settings.label: One role per employer: winner
settings.description: How the winner is chosen across campaigns.

settings.label: Live applications per employer
settings.description: Maximum applications in flight (applying until an end state) at one employer.

settings.label: Employer cooldown
settings.description: Days after an end state (or the applied date, if no reply) before another application to the employer.

settings.label: Default mode
settings.description: Automation mode for a new or imported campaign.

settings.label: Paused
settings.description: Global pause: stops every new outward action at once.

settings.label: Daily cap
settings.description: Maximum applications sent per day.

settings.label: Weekly cap
settings.description: Maximum applications sent per week.

settings.label: Quiet hours start
settings.description: No outward action starts after this time (owner's time zone).

settings.label: Quiet hours end
settings.description: Outward actions may resume at this time.

settings.label: Email send delay
settings.description: Emails wait in the outbox this long and can be cancelled.

settings.label: Unknown form question
settings.description: What happens when a form asks something the answer bank cannot answer.

settings.label: CAPTCHA or sign-in
settings.description: When a runner meets a sign-in or CAPTCHA.

settings.label: Follow-up reminder
settings.description: Remind to follow up this many days after applying with no reply.

settings.label: Open-check freshness
settings.description: A role must have been confirmed open within this many hours to be applied to automatically.

settings.label: Agent step limit
settings.description: Maximum steps an agent task may take.

settings.label: Imminent deadline
settings.description: A snooze is ignored when a role's deadline or a pending action's deadline is this close.

settings.label: Stale pending action
settings.description: Remind the owner when an open pending action has waited this long.

settings.label: Default scope: routine answers
settings.description: Scope pre-selected when the owner answers a routine new question.

settings.label: Default scope: material answers
settings.description: Scope pre-selected for pay, work rights, relocation and declarations.

settings.label: Question match similarity
settings.description: Normalised similarity at which a form question matches a stored answer without asking a model.

settings.label: Wait for confirmation
settings.description: Watch the mailbox this long for a confirmation before asking the owner.

settings.label: Provider
settings.description: Default LLM provider.

settings.label: Allow Claude Code CLI
settings.description: Use the owner's Claude subscription through the CLI on the PC. Never used on a VPS.

settings.label: Model: extract and normalise
settings.description: Extracts structure from postings.

settings.label: Model: classify email
settings.description: Classifies replies.

settings.label: Model: score
settings.description: Scores roles against the rubric.

settings.label: Model: score escalation
settings.description: Re-scores roles near a threshold.

settings.label: Model: custom facets
settings.description: Answers the owner's yes/no questions per job.

settings.label: Model: tailor
settings.description: Writes CVs, letters and requirement matches.

settings.label: Model: unsupported-claim check
settings.description: Second-pass truth check.

settings.label: Model: server browser agent
settings.description: Drives the optional server runner.

settings.label: Output token limit
settings.description: Most tokens a model may write in one call (bounds each call's reserved cost).

settings.label: Request timeout
settings.description: Give up on one model call after this long.

settings.label: Retries
settings.description: Retries after a failed or invalid model reply. Each attempt is budgeted.

settings.label: Route test validity
settings.description: A model route can be activated only after a successful test within this window.

settings.label: Budget currency
settings.description: Currency of the spend ledger.

settings.label: Monthly cap
settings.description: Monthly spend cap in minor units. Unset means paid work stays off.

settings.label: Per-run cap
settings.description: Spend cap per run in minor units. Unset means no per-run cap.

settings.label: Warning
settings.description: Warn when month-to-date spend passes this share of the cap.

settings.label: Agent task ceiling
settings.description: Maximum spend for one agent task, in minor units.

settings.label: Reservation expiry
settings.description: An unreconciled reservation older than this is closed and charged at its estimate.

settings.label: CV pages
settings.description: Maximum CV length.

settings.label: Vault upload limit
settings.description: Largest file the vault accepts.

settings.label: Letter pages
settings.description: Maximum cover letter length.

settings.label: Letter paragraphs
settings.description: Maximum cover letter paragraphs.

settings.label: CV template
settings.description: Default CV template (by template key).

settings.label: Below-threshold text
settings.description: Drop full posting text of below-threshold roles after this many days.

settings.label: Archive unsubmitted roles
settings.description: Archive roles never applied to after this many days.

settings.label: Backup schedule
settings.description: When the nightly backup runs.

settings.label: Copies kept
settings.description: Number of backups kept.

settings.label: Backup target
settings.description: Where backups are written.

settings.label: Digest
settings.description: When the digest is sent.

settings.label: Channels
settings.description: Where notifications go. Empty until a channel is connected.

settings.label: Server runner
settings.description: Run the optional server browser runner. It costs API tokens.

settings.label: Runner offline after
settings.description: Show a runner as offline when not seen for this long.
